results.title: Roscommon outclass Fermanagh to claim first All-Ireland LGFA intermediate title in 21 years
results.description: Roscommon laid the foundations in the opening half as they powered 2-7 to 0-2 ahead at half-time with Aisling Feely scoring both goals.

results.title: Tennis: India’s Ramkumar Ramanathan and Vijay Sundar Prashanth win Bonn Open doubles title
results.description: AMN/ WEB DESK India’s Ramkumar Ramanathan and Vijay Sundar Prashanth clinched the doubles title at the Bonn Open 2026 today. The unseeded Indians defeated England’s Scott Duncan and Sweden’s Adam Heinonen 7-6(4), 6-3 in the one-hour, 31-minute final. results.title: 'Beyond my imagination': Neil Fachie bounces back from dramatic crash to land seventh Commonwealth Games gold
results.description: Fachie bowed out of the international scene in style with a brilliant triumph in front of adoring home crowds at the Sir Chris Hoy Velodrome

results.title: Ex-NBA Star Says Lakers ‘Robbery’ Denied Him a Career-Defining Moment: 'Changed My Whole Career'
results.description: There was a time when the Sacramento Kings stood toe-to-toe with the Los Angeles Lakers. Led by Chris Webber, Vlade Divac, Doug Christie, Peja Stojaković, and Mike Bibby, Sacramento looked destined for the NBA Finals.
